title: Ribbon Mends the Sky

coreLoop: tap to move cloud-riding hero toward a target
enter sky-holes to stitch them closed
track stitched holes, score, and lives
complete six holes to win a round; lose after lives are exhausted; restart
fairness: hero movement must visibly track tap targets and not jitter
holes must be reachable and closure must be visually distinct
demon hits must communicate damage and invulnerability
spawn density and increasing speed must preserve viable choices

reviewFocus: Assess visual hierarchy between hero, holes, demons, shards, HUD, and instructions.
Check whether the core fantasy of repairing the sky is visible in action, not just described in text.
Evaluate tap-to-move precision, collision readability, invulnerability feedback, and whether the staff/bonk mechanic is discoverable.
Check Chinese text legibility, edge clipping, HUD safe areas, round payoff, and difficulty progression.
